narrative.overview: `tulai` is built as a dense, high-trust desktop operational workbench pairing an obsidian-slate full-height navigation rail with crisp edge-to-edge workspace panes divided by single `1px` structural hairlines. Every surface across the Go/MyGo desktop application and companion WebExtension views maintains unified Light and Dark parity so operators can manage concurrent queues across `豆包`, `千问`, `Antigravity`, and `ChatGPT` without boxed-card clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Full-height obsidian-slate navigation shell (`#111622` Light / `#090C12` Dark, `116px` expanded / `44px` collapsed) paired with crisp edge-to-edge workspace canvases (`#FFFFFF` Light / `#131924` Dark) divided by single `1px` structural hairlines (`border` `#E5E9F0` / `#232E40`).
Flat-at-rest panes with zero nested boxed cards, zero rest-state box shadows (`shadow: none`), and `lift` elevation reserved strictly for overlays, tooltips, popovers, drawers, and modals.
Crisp OS native typography (`15px` / `13px` / `12px` / `11px` via `th.Font = ""` / `system-ui`) with mandatory `FontFeatures("tnum")` alignment across counters, quotas, speeds, and timers.
High-contrast borderless semantic status pills (`>= 4.5:1` contrast via `semanticToneColors` in Light mode and `#090D16` `on-primary-dark` ink on `#60A5FA` primary CTAs in Dark mode).
GPU-driven micro-interactions (`150ms` fast transitions, `220ms` UI travel) with explicit `ReduceMotion` / `prefers-reduced-motion` static fallbacks.

rules.name: The Obsidian-Chrome, Paper-Stage Rule
rules.body: Keep the full-height `navRail` anchored in deep obsidian slate (`#111622` Light / `#090C12` Dark) so persistent navigation stays calm and visually separated from the pure-white (`#FFFFFF`) or carbon-slate (`#131924`) operational workspace.

rules.name: The Semantic Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Every borderless badge, lane chip, and alert bar maintains `>= 4.5:1` foreground contrast by mixing Light-mode semantic foregrounds `25%` toward `ink-slate-light` and switching Dark-mode primary button ink to `on-primary-dark` (`#090D16`).

rules.name: The Cool-Slate Parity Rule
rules.body: Desktop MyGo views and `extension/*.html` WebExtension popups/options share synchronized Light and Dark slate/cobalt/emerald/amber/crimson tokens with zero per-page legacy palettes.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Apply `FontFeatures("tnum")` (or `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` in HTML) to every counter, quota meter, elapsed timer, row index, percentage, download speed, and ETA so live updates never jitter horizontally.

rules.name: The Native Four-Step Scale Rule
rules.body: Desktop workbench copy uses the four-step `11px`–`15px` native UI ramp (`display: 15px`, `title: 13px`, `body: 12px`, `caption: 11px`); larger `16.5px`–`20px` headings appear only inside standalone WebExtension `popup.html` and `options.html` surfaces.

rules.name: The Full-Height Rail, Flush-Pane Rule
rules.body: Anchor `navRail` (`116px` / `44px`) edge-to-edge vertically (`0..winH`) aligned with the `34px` topbar, and separate in-page panes with single `1px` structural hairlines rather than inset grey gutters or nested boxes so prompts and generated images command maximum viewport area.

rules.name: The Shadow-Free Rest State Rule
rules.body: Zero box shadows on rest cards, tables, panels, or extension UI (`--shadow: none`); use single `1px` structural hairlines at rest and reserve `lift` shadows strictly for floating tooltips, popovers, drawers, modals, and the log console.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Fidelity Rule
rules.body: GPU transitions run at `150ms` (`motionFast`) for micro-interactions (`scale(1.012)` hover, `scale(0.985)` press, floating labels, color anims) and `220ms` (`motionUI`) for `12px` travel/reveal transitions without list-height reflow, degrading cleanly to static or opacity-only states when `ReduceMotion` is enabled.

rules.name: The Zero-Nesting Corner Rule
rules.body: Use `0` radius on flush hairline split panes, `5px` on interactive controls, `6px` on standalone cards and prompt editors, `8px` on floating overlays, and `999px` on borderless pills—never nest rounded bordered boxes inside other rounded bordered boxes.

dos: **Do** derive every surface, rail tone, border, text, and semantic tone from `workbenchTokens(dark)` and shared helpers (`uiCardSurface`, `uiBadge`, `uiPrimaryBtn`, `uiBtn`, `uiIconBtn`, `uiPill`, `uiPromptArea`) in `internal/ui/design.go`.
**Do** apply `FontFeatures("tnum")` (and `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` in HTML) on all counters, quota meters, elapsed timers, row indices, percentages, download speeds, and ETAs.

**Do** enforce `>= 4.5:1` contrast across all borderless semantic badges and primary CTAs using `semanticToneColors` in Light mode and `on-primary-dark` (`#090D16`) ink on `#60A5FA` primary buttons in Dark mode.
**Do** keep all browser login, verification, and page-bridge workflows inside built-in `Camoufox` environments (`browserDrawerView`) and `extbridge` extension surfaces.

**Do** preserve the full-height obsidian shell (`navRail` `116px` / `44px` spanning `0..winH`, `34px` `nav-head` & `topbar`) and flush hairline split panes so prompt editors and output images command viewport space.
donts: **Don't** nest bordered cards inside bordered cards, draw duplicate page headers, or add rest-state box shadows (`--shadow: none`) on panes or extension views.
**Don't** put `nav-toggle` in `topbar` or wrap `topbar` across `navRail` with overhang; keep `nav-toggle` aligned inside the `34px` `nav-head` column.
**Don't** duplicate button label text nodes (`ui.ButtonBase(...).Label(x)` + `ui.Text(c, x)`)—use single-node `uiPrimaryBtn` / `ui.Button`.
**Don't** render low-contrast grey-on-grey labels, `#FFFFFF` text on Dark `#60A5FA` primary CTAs, or thick `>1px` decorative accent bars.

**Don't** put top-level `motion`, `shadows`, or `breakpoints` keys in `DESIGN.md` YAML frontmatter (keep them in `.impeccable/design.json` `extensions`), and don't animate list row heights during enter/exit transitions.
**Don't** launch, control, or design UI flows around external browsers (`Chrome`, `Edge`, `Chromium`) outside the built-in `Camoufox` runtime and `extbridge` extension UI.
